tools.description: Search past decisions the user already made. Call before raising a ticket.

repo.description: Repository path to match repo-scoped decisions against. Default: your session's repository.

tags.description: Return only decisions carrying at least one of these tags.

tools.name: search_decisions

tools.description: Raise a decision ticket for the user: a question, 2 to 4 options, your recommendation and why.

context.description: What you know: files, constraints, what you tried.

recommendation.description: The key of the option you recommend.

mode.description: blocking: end your turn and wait. assume: proceed with your recommendation; irreversible choices must block.

assumption.description: Required for assume: what you will proceed with.

scope.description: How far the answer applies as precedent. Default repo.

differs_from.description: A decision id that looks similar but does not settle this.

tools.name: request_decision

tools.description: Read a ticket's status and, once decided, the answer.
tools.name: check_decision

tools.description: Withdraw your own open ticket, giving the reason or the past decision that settles it.

precedent_id.description: The past decision that settles this, if one does.

tools.name: withdraw_decision
